description: Port universe for MSC (Mediterranean Shipping Company). MSC provides PORT-TO-PORT schedules only (no inland rail), so v3 has NO inland scrape / derive / secondary pass: it simply loops each origin over these ports. Keys from msc_yards.geojson, with the two MSC-nested co-located ports split out so each is called separately with its own name (see /synth.md and msc_citiesv3.json): Los Angeles/Long Beach and Miami/Port Everglades. type is always port. [v2 copy — independent from v3 coverage.json so the two workers never affect each other's call set.]
